category: German multihoster selling prepaid traffic packages

free_tier.stated: No free traffic on this tariff; it is the first paid level. The free tariff is a separate record.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated: there is no per-file ceiling, only a traffic balance that a file consumes

retention.stated: A package expires with its term: '1 Monat' is defined in the terms as 30 days (720 hours). Packages bought 'ohne Ablauf' keep their traffic until used, with a 10%-a-month service deduction after 24 months of inactivity, and end absolutely on 19 January 2038.

egress.terms: Traffic is the product: a package buys a number of GB that are consumed by downloads and expire with the package term. Premium users are charged only for traffic actually used, and some hosts are billed at 33% or 50% of the bytes transferred.
egress.free_allowance: none; the package volume is the allowance
egress.price_per_tb: EUR 12.00 per TB for 30 days at the 1 TB package

interface_detail: JSON API at high-way.me/api/ documented through a public Postman collection; WebDAV, FTP and SFTP for the user's own content; JDownloader and pyLoad integrations.
tooling: API, WebDAV/FTP/SFTP, JDownloader, pyLoad, a Windows tool and an Android TV app. The API's /hoster endpoint returns each host's discount factor, so a client can compute the real traffic cost of a download before making it.
chaining: The only service here that sells traffic by the terabyte with a published per-TB price, which makes it the natural overflow for a month that would break a flat plan - at EUR 12 a TB for 30 days, or EUR 9.17 a TB when bought as 12 TB for a year.

limits.value: 250 GB / 500 GB / 750 GB / 1 TB per 30 days at EUR 5.99 / 7.50 / 9.00 / 12.00; 3 TB per year at EUR 47.99
unused traffic expires with the package term; the 'ohne Ablauf' packages lose 10% of the original volume a month after 24 months of non-use
vetted registration, review takes a few hours, registrations only open in windows

limits_note: Only 16 filehosters in total are offered ('von über 16 Filehostern'), of which the free tariff reaches 5 and Premium adds 'über 10 weitere'; the rest of the value is usenet, torrent and a 39-channel TV recorder.
binding_note: Every plan here is a byte balance, so the meter is the plan. A 1 TiB month needs 1.1 TB of packages, which is EUR 13.20 at the 1 TB rate or two 500 GB packages for EUR 15.00; nothing else in the vocabulary is close to firing first.

identity_cost.detail: E-mail registration plus manual review, and a forum account, which the terms make a prerequisite for every service. Payment by card, PaysafeCard, Amazon coupon or similar.

reliability_note: Traffic is deducted at download time and does not survive the package term; the platform is German-language and deliberately admits few users; a download manager that opens several connections can be billed for more bytes than the file size.
confidence_note: Package prices and volumes, the 30-day definition, the expiry rules and the host count each come from a vendor page read today. The tariff page's 'ab mtl. EUR 3,99' does not match any package on the package page and is recorded as unreconciled rather than resolved.

evidence.proved: the Premium package ladder: 1 month 250 GB EUR 5.99, 500 GB EUR 7.50, 750 GB EUR 9.00, 1 TB EUR 12.00; 1 year 3 TB EUR 47.99; 2 years 6 TB EUR 95.99; no-expiry 250 GB EUR 10.00 and 1 TB EUR 32.50
'Premium, ab mtl. € 3,99' with 'über 10 weitere Filehoster', usenet with 10 connections, torrent downloader, TV recorder, WebDAV/FTP streaming, and 'von über 16 Filehostern'
'1 Monat' means 30 days (720 hours), decimal byte definitions, the 10%-a-month deduction on idle no-expiry packages, and the 2038 end date
premium users are charged only for traffic actually used, with 33% and 50% host discounts

price_per_tb_month: EUR 12.00 per TB per 30 days; EUR 9.17 per TB at 12 TB for one year (EUR 110.00); EUR 16.00 per TB at 3 TB for one year (EUR 47.99)
notes: that is the 250 GB package, not a flat month, so the same money buys a fifth of a terabyte and the per-TB price is what a reader needs. The cheapest per-TB is the 1 TB and 750 GB 30-day packages at EUR 12.00, both identical, so volume above 750 GB a month is linear at that rate. Twelve filehosters plus usenet is a narrow catalogue compared with the French and Dutch services, which is the caveat.

extras.filehosters: 16 total (5 free + over 10 more on Premium)
